_doc: F1(a) from the 2026-09-20 adversarial security review, and the DANGEROUS pole of this whole check. SAME BYTES as clean-not-applicable-consumer except `delegateReadError` is set: the delegate is on disk but could NOT BE READ (EACCES, a directory at that path, a symlink loop). Before the fix, `defaultReadFile` had a bare catch folding every errno into null, so this state arrived as `delegatePresent: false` and arm (0) returned `n/a` -- the single most REASSURING verdict available (`the question does not apply here`) -- on the repo whose own comment calls this hook the only gate that exists. n/a is a POSITIVE claim that the delegate is ABSENT FROM DISK; a read that failed establishes no such thing. instrument-discipline.md MUST-1: the check could not look, and that is not a finding about the subject.
